commands.name: age
commands.description: Tells you the age of the server

commands.name: casual
commands.description: Politely asks everyone in the room to move to the #casual channel (does nothing in said channel)

commands.name: cg
commands.description: This command can be used to quickly find a color guide page using our website's search.

options.name: name
options.description: Enter the character or object's name. Does not need to be the full name.

options.name: guide
options.description: name of the guide to search in, defaults to the Friendship is Magic guide

commands.name: db
commands.description: Searches Derpibooru and returns the first result. Default filter is applied outside #nsfw

options.name: query
options.description: Search query (same syntax is used for searching as on the site itself)

options.name: sort
options.description: Same as "Sort by" on the actual site (default: `id`)

options.name: as-link
options.description: When true, simply returns the link to the search page instead of embedding the first result

options.name: brief
options.description: When specified, details like the description, uploader and counters will not be shown in the embed

commands.name: fixnick
commands.description: Change how your DeviantArt username is displayed alongside your Discord name

commands.name: joined
commands.description: Tells you when you joined the server

commands.name: nice
commands.description: Replies with a YouTube link to JoJo saying "Nice!"

commands.name: rekt
commands.description: Replies with a YouTube link to the MLG Air Horn sound effect

options.name: role
options.description: The role you would like to assign or remove

options.name: member
options.description: **Staff only!** The user whose roles you want to change

options.name: action
options.description: What to do with the provided role (default: `toggle`)

commands.name: say
commands.description: Send a message to the specified channel as the bot.

options.name: channel
options.description: The channel in which to send the message

commands.name: tut
commands.description: Sends a link to the club's Tutorials folder to the channel.

options.name: sub-folder
options.description: Allows linking to an application-specific subfolder

commands.name: update-rules
commands.description: Updates the rules in the #welcome channel

commands.name: version
commands.description: Returns the currently running bot version with a link to the code changes

commands.name: welcome
commands.description: Welcomes the specified user as the bot

options.name: member
options.description: The name of the user to welcome

commands.name: yes
commands.description: Replies with a YouTube link to Mr. Bison saying "Yes" repeatedly
